family.title: The Martinez Family

solo.title: Sarah the Explorer
solo.subtitle: Digital Nomad's Adventure
solo.description: A solo digital nomad in her late 20s embarks on a 14-day multi-destination journey, seeking authentic experiences, reliable logistics, and local insights in La Fortuna, Monteverde, and Santa Teresa.

touchpoints.title: Logistics Setup
touchpoints.customer_action: Lands at SJO, receives a local eSIM and a clear itinerary for her multi-leg trip.
touchpoints.mr_wright_action: Agent provides an eSIM and a welcome packet with all tickets and confirmations.

touchpoints.title: Luggage Forwarding
touchpoints.customer_action: Travels light on a shuttle to La Fortuna while her large suitcase is securely transported ahead.
touchpoints.mr_wright_action: Uses a trusted luggage partner to move the main bag to her next hotel.

touchpoints.title: Volcano Hike
touchpoints.customer_action: Joins a small-group guided hike to the Arenal Volcano, booked seamlessly.
touchpoints.mr_wright_action: Books a highly-rated local guide, avoiding tourist traps.

touchpoints.title: Final Leg

touchpoints.mr_wright_action: Coordinates the final, complex departure logistics, ensuring on-time arrival.
